provenance: Live probes issued 2026-09-19 from the editing sandbox via the page-fetch tool against api.fda.gov and accessdata.fda.gov (the sandbox has no bulk network; one-off primary checks only). Excerpts are transcribed verbatim from the JSON/HTML responses. Full request URLs are preserved so every probe can be re-issued by hand. openFDA search clauses match across nested submission objects (flattened semantics): a total=1 match confirms the queried facts coexist on the live application record, while the precise same-submission linkage is established by the committed full-record extraction (dual-run byte-identical raw responses, run 18 vs run 19 manifests). Where the ORIG block itself fell inside the returned chunk it is quoted verbatim.
